response.text: The columns are uppercase, so they need quoting.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" < p."STRT_DT" or h."POST_DT" > p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT") order by 1

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on upper(trim(c."ACCT_CD"))=upper(trim(l."ACCT_CD")) where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

select h."JRNL_NO", h."INV_ID", h."INV_AMT", h."STAT_CD", s.dr, s.cr, s.cnt from "APINVH" h left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr, count(*) cnt from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO") s on s."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where s."JRNL_NO" is null or s.dr<>h."INV_AMT" or s.cr<>h."INV_AMT" order by 1

select upper(regexp_replace(ltrim(trim("INV_NO"),'0'),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) k, trim("VEND_CD") v, count(*) c, array_agg("INV_ID" order by "INV_ID") ids, array_agg("INV_AMT") amts, array_agg("INV_NO") nos from "APINVH" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1 order by 1
